name: history-backup-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker backend for the Full Browsing History extension's Cloud Backup feature. Proxies gzipped daily history TSVs to a private R2 bucket you own.

BACKUP_TOKEN.description: The extension's Cloud Backup password. Any long random string works — generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`, or paste one from a password generator. Save it: you'll paste this same value into the extension's Settings > Cloud Backup > "Backup token" field.

BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for storing your gzipped daily history backups. Created and bound automatically — no action needed here.
